title: Where AI Meets Crypto
summary: The most overhyped intersection in tech, with a few genuinely interesting threads. The honest taxonomy, verifiable inference, decentralized compute, agent wallets, provenance, and what fails when probabilistic systems meet deterministic ledgers.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish AI-on-chain, chain-for-AI, and the marketing layer in between.
Explain what zero-knowledge ML actually proves and what it doesn't.
Describe decentralized GPU markets and the economics that decide whether they survive.
Explain what an agent wallet is and what changes when software earns and spends.
Describe cryptographic provenance and proof-of-human approaches.
Identify what breaks when you put a probabilistic system on a deterministic ledger.
